system.summary: Homophonic alphabet of about 37 signs for Italian, with nulls marked by a subscript 8 or 9, double letters written as pseudo-words (bur, bor, bar, mur, F r), five code words, and ordered null strings. No word division.

diacritics.note: A subscript 8 or 9 cancels the sign; a raised 9 on the stroke makes it the sign p.

system.doubled_letters: special sign: pseudo-words bur tt, bor ss, bar rr, mur ll, F r cc
system.notes: K stands for o and also where u or v is needed. Subscript 9 under Z may be a g in three places; not tested.

prior_solution.where: None found. Open: an essay by Lino Chiesi on the Capilupi-Gonzaga correspondence and a calendar entry for Camillo Capilupo were not seen (3 Nov 2026).

conditions.human_role: WAINUT set the task (catalogue 1565) and the rules; AI language-model agents located the letters, transcribed, built the key, read and checked. No target-specific human intervention. No human palaeographer checked the text.
tools: scripts in this folder (annealer, concordance, held-out test, mark checker)
models: AI language-model agents (WAINUT), viewing the images

solution.what: Images fetched from Estense IIIF; native size by region requests.
cc. 15-16 transcribed sign by sign from enlarged strips with no key.
Neighbouring Capilupi tables (1556, 1560) tried on the letter; neither fits.
Homophonic annealing on Italian 4-grams; subscript marks found to cancel a sign by scoring with and without them.
Table frozen on c. 15r, applied to cc. 15v-16r: -7.435 per letter against shuffled tables mean -10.168, best -9.326. Scrambled sign order control also passes.
Digits of cc. 48 and 49r: no fixed pair grid; stopped as too short, with no matched control.

Independent blind check: 184 signs of c. 15v before any solver file, 10 differences, 5.4%; 3 of 184, 1.6%, after the reader's two label failures. Key confirmed; status corrected; 19 unmarked repairs found.
Pass 3 on crops where the sense broke: signs changed on 8 lines plus v05, clear text on 2 lines. Found with the sense in view, not blind.
Reading rebuilt from a marked source; every repair marked and checked by script.
Four web searches found no edition; the Chiesi essay and one calendar entry not seen.

outcome.method_basis: Key recovered by homophonic annealing on the signs of c. 15r and refined by hand; no pairs and no contemporary decipherment. Code words by context; two are confirmed by the docket on c. 16v.
outcome.fraction_read_source: cc. 15-16: 233 of 293 cipher words read as sense, 214 with no restored or changed letter (scripts/check_marks.py c15_16). cc. 48 and 49r, 641 digits, perhaps 50 words if letters take 2-3 digits, are unread; 233 of about 343 gives this rough share of the whole.

texts.label: cc. 15-16, 8 May 1545
texts.summary: A cardinal, very likely Otto Truchsess, dictates news to Capilupi at Worms for Ferrante Gonzaga: the Marchese del Vasto, Prince Doria and Genoa, the Farnese marriage, whether there will be war this year, and his wish to have Ferrante at court to urge the Emperor against the Lutherans.
texts.note: Cipher words 293: as sense 233 (79.5%), no restored or changed letter 214 (73.0%), 26 doubtful, 23 code words, 11 not read.
